ambient.englishDescription: A mood or an ambient surrounding the place.

cctv.definitionKo: 감시, 방범, 화재 예방 등의 특정한 목적으로 특정 수신자에게 화상을 전송하는 텔레비전 방식.
cctv.englishDescription: A television method that transmits images to specific recipients for specific purposes such as surveillance, crime prevention, and fire prevention.

extension.definitionKo: 길이나 시간, 거리 등을 본래보다 길게 늘림.
extension.englishDescription: The act of elongating length, time, distance, etc.

extension.definitionKo: 어떤 일의 계속. 또는 하나로 이어지는 것.
extension.englishDescription: The continuance of something, or the extension of something to something else.

extension.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 현상, 행위 등이 계속하여 이어지는 것.
extension.englishDescription: The state of a matter, phenomenon, act, etc., are continued.

extension.definitionKo: 일정한 개념이 적용되는 사물의 모든 범위.
extension.englishDescription: The whole range of objects to which a certain concept is applied.

extension.definitionKo: 어떤 일의 영향이 차차 다른 데로 퍼져 미침.
extension.englishDescription: The state of the effect of something spreading to other areas gradually.

extension.definitionKo: 시설, 사업, 세력 등을 늘려서 넓힘.
extension.englishDescription: An act of increasing the size or scope of a facility, business, force, etc., to make it larger.
An act of widening something to make it larger.

fabricated.definitionKo: 사실이 아닌 것을 거짓이나 상상으로 만들어 낸.
fabricated.englishDescription: Untrue or unreal, and made up with one's imagination or by lying.

fabricated.definitionKo: 사실과 다르거나 실제로는 없었던 일을 사실처럼 꾸며 만드는 성질을 띤.
fabricated.englishDescription: Characterized by having a quality of making something untrue or unreal look true through fabrication.

fluffy.definitionKo: 매우 작고 보드라운 털 같은 것이 돋아 있다.
fluffy.englishDescription: Having very short and soft hair or something similar to that.

good-looking.englishDescription: One's face looking pretty or handsome.
Having a pleasing and attractive appearance.
One's face being pretty or handsome.
An appearance being tidy and handsome.

good-looking.definitionKo: 사람의 생김새나 됨됨이 등이 보통을 넘는 상태이다.
good-looking.englishDescription: Being above par or average in appearance, personality, etc.

good-looking.definitionKo: 외모나 성품 등이 모난 데가 없이 참하고 복이 있어 보이는 데가 있다.
good-looking.englishDescription: Seeming to have a good personality, appearance, etc., and enjoy good luck.

goryeocheongja.definitionKo: 고려 시대에 만든 푸른 빛깔의 자기.
goryeocheongja.englishDescription: A blue-green celadon made during the Goryeo Dynasty.

interpose.englishDescription: To step in between two or more things.

jultagi.definitionKo: 공중에 쳐 놓은 줄 위에서 걷거나 여러 재주를 보이는 민속놀이.
jultagi.englishDescription: tightrope walking: A traditional Korean art of walking along, or performing various moves, on a rope hanging in the air.

notice.definitionKo: 관청이나 단체에서 어떤 내용을 널리 알리려고 쓴 글.
notice.englishDescription: A written statement by a government office or organization to announce something.

notice.definitionKo: 어떤 내용을 소개하여 알려 주는 글.
notice.englishDescription: The document in which the introduction to a certain content or event is written.

notice.definitionKo: 많은 사람들에게 어떤 내용을 널리 알림.
notice.englishDescription: An act of informing many people of certain information.

notice.definitionKo: 많은 사람들에게 널리 알리는 내용이나 사항.
notice.englishDescription: Content or information that is widely spread to many people.

notice.definitionKo: 어떤 사실을 게시나 글을 통해 알림.
notice.englishDescription: An act of informing people of something by posting it up or by transmitting it in writing
To perceive with eyes the existence or appearance of an object.
To notice someone else's shortcomings or weaknesses.
A document conveying a certain fact.

notice.definitionKo: 어떤 사실을 문서로 알림. 또는 그 문서.
notice.englishDescription: An act of informing someone of a certain fact in a document; or such a document.

notice.definitionKo: 어떤 사실을 알리기 위해 일정한 표시를 해 놓은 판.
notice.englishDescription: A board on which a specific mark is seen to inform the public of a certain fact.

notice.definitionKo: 어떤 사실이나 소식을 글이나 말로 전하여 알림.
notice.englishDescription: An act of conveying and informing a certain fact or news in writing or speech.
An act of announcing or notifying something in speech or writing

notice.definitionKo: 관청이나 단체에서 어떤 내용을 널리 알림.
notice.englishDescription: A public office or organization announcing news to the public.

overstatement.definitionKo: 바늘만 한 것을 몽둥이만 하다고 말한다는 뜻으로 작은 일을 크게 부풀려서 말함.
overstatement.englishDescription: An act of exaggerating in one's description of a small thing or a trivial incident, from its literal meaning of "to call a needle a club".

overstatement.definitionKo: 작은 일을 불려서 크게 말하는 일.

rado.definitionKo: 그것이 최선은 아니나 여럿 중에서는 그런대로 괜찮음을 나타내는 조사.
rado.englishDescription: A postpositional word used to indicate that it is not the best option but the most acceptable among many options.
A postpositional word used when it is similar to other cases.

rado.definitionKo: 시간이나 수량을 나타내는 말에 붙어 그 의미를 강조할 때 쓰는 조사.
rado.englishDescription: A postpositional word used when being attached to a word that expresses time or amount, and intending to emphasize its meaning.

rado.definitionKo: 유사한 것을 예로 들어 설명할 때 쓰는 조사.
rado.englishDescription: A postpositional word used when explaining something by giving an example of a similar thing.

rado.definitionKo: 불확실한 사실에 대한 말하는 이의 의심이나 의문을 나타내는 조사.
rado.englishDescription: A postpositional word that indicates the speaker's doubt or question about an unclear fact.

softball.definitionKo: 9~15명으로 이루어진 두 팀이 크고 부드러운 공으로 야구와 비슷하게 하는 경기. 또는 그 경기에서 쓰는 공.
softball.englishDescription: A sports game similar to baseball played by two teams of 9~15 people each with a big, soft ball, or the ball used in such a game.

spontaneous.englishDescription: Coming out or being created naturally.

storage.englishDescription: The state of having a thing in one's keeping.
An act of keeping something safely.

storage.definitionKo: 집안 살림에 쓰는 물건 등을 보관해 두는 장소.
storage.englishDescription: A place in the house, used to store household goods.

storage.definitionKo: 컴퓨터를 비롯한 디지털 기기에서, 수치나 명령 등을 기억하는 장치.
storage.englishDescription: A device which remembers figures, orders, etc., in digital machines such as the computer.

storage.definitionKo: 여러 가지 물건을 모아 두거나 넣어 두는 곳.
storage.englishDescription: A place in which goods and merchandise are collected or stored.
The act of collecting and keeping items, goods, etc.

storage.definitionKo: 물건이나 재화 등을 모아서 보관해 두는 창고.
storage.englishDescription: A space for keeping collected items, goods, etc.

storage.definitionKo: 막 쓰는 물건을 쌓아 두는 창고.
storage.englishDescription: A storage place for keeping miscellaneous things.

storage.definitionKo: 물건 등을 어떤 곳에 넣어 둠.
storage.englishDescription: The act of keeping an object, etc., in a certain place.

suit.definitionKo: 공식적인 자리에서 주로 입는 격식을 차린 옷.
suit.englishDescription: Formal clothes worn primarily on official occasions.
A suit that grown-up males wear.

suit.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 의도나 기분 등에 맞게 행동하다.
suit.englishDescription: To act as someone intends or is pleased.

walkaway.englishDescription: The victory won easily without difficulty.

wide.englishDescription: The width of something being long.

wide.definitionKo: 길이 험하거나 가파른 곳이 없이 평평하고 넓다.
wide.englishDescription: A road being flat and wide without bumps or slopes.

wide.definitionKo: 물건의 겉이 높낮이가 없이 고르고 넓다.
wide.englishDescription: The surface of an object being evenly flat and wide, with no difference of height.
A floor being even and widely spread.
The scope or arena of something being wide.
